get.cmd: bw --nointeraction list items | jq -r 'map(select(.name == "{{key}}")) | .[0].login.password // ("secret not found" | halt_error(1))'

set.cmd: id=$(bw --nointeraction list items </dev/null | jq -r 'map(select(.name == "{{key}}")) | .[0].id // empty'); jq -Rs '{ object: "item", type: 1, name: "{{key}}", notes: null, favorite: false, login: { username: null, password: ., totp: null } }' | bw --nointeraction encode | { if [ -n "$id" ]; then bw --nointeraction edit item "$id"; else bw --nointeraction create item; fi; } >/dev/null

delete.cmd: bw --nointeraction delete item --permanent "$(bw --nointeraction list items | jq -r 'map(select(.name == "{{key}}")) | .[0].id')" >/dev/null
